raw_text:
PLAN "Couch-to-5K for exercise-induced asthma (12 weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary endurance:
    name "Complete 5K run"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Base and controlled breathing" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Walk and easy jog 1":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x10..10 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          jogging 1x1..1 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          walking 1x10..10 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 9m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Intervals - short jogs":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x1..1 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          walking 1x8..8 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          jogging 1x1..1 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          walking 1x8..8 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Easy continuous walk/jog":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x20..20 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 9m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Build time jogging":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x2..2 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          walking 1x8..8 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Intervals - increased jog":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x2..2 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          walking 1x6..6 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          jogging 1x2..2 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Easy continuous jog/walk":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x3..3 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          walking 1x7..7 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Longer steady jog":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x4..4 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          walking 1x6..6 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Mixed intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x3..3 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          walking 1x5..5 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          jogging 1x3..3 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Easy continuous jog":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x5..5 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Steady jog with controlled breathing":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x6..6 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Paced intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x4..4 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          walking 1x4..4 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          jogging 1x4..4 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Recovery walk/jog":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x20..20 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Increasing volume and consistency" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Longer steady run":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x8..8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 15m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Tempo intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x5..5 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          walking 1x5..5 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          jogging 1x5..5 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Easy run":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x9..9 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 15m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Progressive steady run":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x10..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 15m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Interval repeats":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x6..6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          walking 1x4..4 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          jogging 1x6..6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Easy continuous run":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x11..11 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 15m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Long run steady":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x12..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 18m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Mixed pace intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x6..6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          jogging 1x4..4 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          walking 1x4..4 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Easy run with breathing focus":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x10..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 15m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Steady longer run":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x14..14 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 16m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Intervals - sustained effort":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x8..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          walking 1x4..4 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Recovery and technique":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x20..20 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m

  PHASE "Phase 3 - Race preparation and taper" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Race-pace practice":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x16..16 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 19m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Intervals at race effort":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x6..6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          jogging 1x6..6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 13m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Easy run":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x12..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Long steady run":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x18..18 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 17m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Tempo intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x8..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          walking 1x4..4 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          jogging 1x8..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 13m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Recovery jog":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x12..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Reduced volume, maintain intensity":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x12..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 13m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Short sharp intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x4..4 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          jogging 1x4..4 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Easy run and prep":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x10..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Tapered easy run":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x8..8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 7m
      DAY Wednesday training 20m "Openers":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x4..4 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          jogging 1x2..2 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 20m "Race day prep - easy":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x10..10 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
